h1: Where can I find a daily devotional for Black women?
meta_description: Find a quiet space for your daily walk with the Lord. Peace Be Still offers whispered scripture, Bible stories told in a Black church voice, and Spanish resources.
direct_answer: Peace Be Still is a nightly practice and morning companion for women seeking the Lord. It provides the King James Bible, whispered Psalms, and Bible stories told in a Black church voice in Hush Harbor. You can use the free lane forever, or choose a paid lane for full access to all features.

sections.heading: Finding a quiet place to read
paragraphs: The morning is a good time to sit with the Word. Many women look for a space that feels like home. Peace Be Still offers a place to read or hear the King James Bible. You can start your day with a daily Bible story. These stories include Bible stories told in a Black church voice in Hush Harbor. It is a simple way to keep your heart turned toward the Lord. You do not need to rush. The app is built for a slow and steady walk through the scriptures.

Some days feel heavy. You may want to hear the Psalms whispered at the end of the day. This nightly practice helps you settle your thoughts. You can set a sleep timer to help you rest. The app also features an AI Bible chat. It is clearly labeled as AI. It will quote KJV verses word for word for you. It is a tool to help you study the text. You can find what you need without any surprise charges.
bullets: Read the full King James Bible.
Enjoy Bible stories told in a Black church voice.
Use the AI Bible chat for study.

sections.heading: A practice for the whole family
paragraphs: Faith is a journey for the whole house. If your family speaks Spanish, Mi Refugio is there for you. It uses the Reina-Valera 1909. You can read the Bible and use the chat in Spanish. It is a way to bring the Word into your home in a language that feels natural. We believe in keeping things plain and honest. There are no ads to interrupt your time with the Lord. You can choose to stay in the free lane forever. If you want more, you can choose the paid lane.

There are no trials to track. You will not find surprise charges on your statement. We want you to feel at peace when you open the app. It is a tool, not a distraction. Whether you are a mother, a grandmother, or a young woman starting her walk, there is a place for you here. The app is coming soon to the App Store and Google Play.

sections.heading: Walking with the Word
paragraphs: "Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path." (Psalm 119:105). This is the foundation of our work. We do not offer quick fixes or magic words. We offer the text of the Bible. You can read it or hear it. The whispered readings are meant to help you focus on the scripture. The Bible stories told in a Black church voice help you see yourself in the history of the faith. It is a simple, unhurried way to live out your devotion.

Take your time with the verses. Let them sink into your heart. The AI chat is there if you have a question about a specific verse. It will only give you the KJV text. It does not add its own thoughts. This keeps the focus on the Word itself. We hope this becomes a steady part of your morning and your night.

sections.heading: Your daily rhythm
paragraphs: A daily practice is about showing up. It is not about being perfect. It is about being present. You can open the app while you drink your coffee. You can open it when you lay your head down at night. The interface is clean and quiet. It is designed to be a sanctuary on your phone. You can trust that the content will remain true to the scripture. We are preparing the app for you now.
Look for Peace Be Still in the App Store and Google Play.

faq.q: Is there a cost to use the app?
faq.a: You can use a free lane forever. There is also a paid lane available for a monthly or yearly fee. There are no trials, no ads, and no surprise charges.

faq.q: Can I hear the Bible in Spanish?
faq.a: Yes. Mi Refugio provides the Bible and a chat feature in Spanish using the Reina-Valera 1909. It is designed for families who prefer to read or hear the Word in their own language.

faq.q: How does the AI Bible chat work?
faq.a: The AI Bible chat is a tool to help you study. It is clearly labeled as AI. It will only provide answers by quoting King James Version verses word for word.
The nightly practice involves using the app to hear whispered Psalms for sleep. You can use a sleep timer to help you settle your mind at the end of the day.

facts.claim: The King James Version of the Bible is one of the most widely distributed books in history.
The Reina-Valera 1909 is a classic Spanish translation of the Bible.
